challengeFindings.title: Two branches that each change a folder's word total conflict on the record's `ceiling` line, and `check`, `lower` and `raise` all crash on the conflict markers, so a resumed build or debug rebase fails to a handover and ship needs a hand-picked ceiling (a second owner raise when both sides were raised)

A moved, renamed or emptied text folder counts as 0 words; `check` tells the agent to run `lower`, and `lower` (no reason needed) writes a `0` ceiling, so the guard passes from then on and never counts the folder's new home

An agent runs `lower` while another agent's prompt edit sits uncommitted in the same working tree; the record bakes that edit in, the agent commits only its own files, and the committed tree then fails `check` as above the ceiling with an empty growth list and an owner-only raise as the only named fix

A record left with merge-conflict markers or other invalid JSON makes `check`, `lower` and `raise` die with a raw `SyntaxError` stack at `<anonymous_script>:3` that names neither the record path nor a fix
An agent told to turn a red unit gate green runs the `raise` command that the failure text prints, or edits the record by hand, and the owner-only ceiling rises with no owner involved

challengeFindings.title: A build or debug run that edits only workflow or prompt text never runs the ceiling test in its own gates, because `bkit:gate:changed` picks only test files that name a changed path or its basename and `agent-text-ceiling.test.ts` names none, so the group and holistic gates pass and the ceiling first fails at the ship push or in CI

The non-interactive `raise` test pipes `yes\n`, a word the prompt never accepts, so it stays green with the terminal check deleted, and `printf 'RAISE\n' | pnpm bkit:text:ceiling raise --reason x` from an agent's shell would then rewrite the record with no test failing

When bkit's own folders sit below the ceiling, a folder is missing or the record is invalid JSON, the unit gate shows only `AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0` at `agent-text-ceiling.test.ts:301`, because the real-repo case drops the script's output, so the agent never sees `pnpm bkit:text:ceiling lower` or the record message

Run through a symlinked path with `--preserve-symlinks-main` (as a flag or in `NODE_OPTIONS`), `check` never reaches `main` and exits 0 with no output while a total is above its ceiling, because `isEntryScript` compares a resolved `argv[1]` with an unresolved `import.meta.url`

After a record conflict between an owner `raise` and an agent `lower`, an agent that follows the invalid-JSON message ("Take either side") can keep the lowered side; the merged total is then above that ceiling, so `lower` refuses and only a second owner raise clears it; the message also names `scripts/gate/bkit-text-ceiling.json` when `--record` points elsewhere
Ending the input at the `Type RAISE` prompt (EOF) leaves `rl.question` unsettled, so `raise` exits 0 with no message, and a chained `&& git commit` goes ahead as if the raise had run

An agent pipes `RAISE` into `script -q /dev/null pnpm bkit:text:ceiling raise --reason x` from its non-terminal shell and the ceiling rises with no owner, yet `docs/testing.md:574` says the record is written only after the owner types the confirmation and `docs/security.md` lists no such control
An agent whose `check` failed above the ceiling tries `lower` next, and the refusal hands it the ready-to-paste `pnpm bkit:text:ceiling raise --reason "<why>"` line that `check` no longer prints

challengeFindings.title: A PR grows a workflow above its ceiling, and the CI unit job (a `fetch-depth: 1` checkout) prints `Files that grew most:` with no file under it, because `git log -1 -- {record}` in a shallow clone returns the shallow boundary commit, so every file's delta against it is 0

An agent step deletes an unused prompt file and updates `.bkit/prompts.md`; `bkit tests changed` passes only files that still exist, so `bkit-gate-changed.mjs` never sees the deleted path, skips the ceiling test and goes green, and the below-ceiling failure first shows at a later gate that runs the whole unit tier

The ceiling test file is renamed or moved and `CEILING_TEST` keeps the old path; the `named` stage hands it to `vitest run --passWithNoTests`, which prints `No test files found, exiting with code 0`, so every workflow or prompt change passes the changed-file gate with no ceiling check
